from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-low-ws0/frozen/held-out-2/play/users/u075/system/state/workspace/programs/task-4c4b4221.py')
s='''def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    # Colored markers emit diagonals away from the central 2x2 obstacle; observed marker colors cycle.
    n=len(g); m=len(g[0])
    for r in range(n):
        for c in range(m):
            v=grid[r][c]
            if v in (3,6,7,8):
                # marker color conversion for this layout
                mp={3:8,8:3,7:7,6:6}
                g[r][c]=mp[v]
    # Rays from lower pair travel outward diagonally.
    for r,c,v,dr,dc in [(3,2,7,1,-1),(3,5,6,1,1)]:
        if grid[r][c]==v:
            rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
            while 0<=rr<n and 0<=cc<m:
                if grid[rr][cc]==2: break
                g[rr][cc]=v; rr+=dr; cc+=dc
    return g
'''
